_note: Blurbs written by hand, for things no collector can reach. Merged last by build/extras.py, so anything here wins over a scraped value. Keyed the way the page looks each group up: gn and ep by code, evo and site by exact title.

167b.d: A reprint collection gathering six novels that follow Hiro Nakamura: Walls, Part 2; The Trial of the Black Bear; Past Experience; Baby Power; Stolen Fate; and The Trip, Part 1. Nothing in it was new -- it was a way back in for readers who had lost the thread.

1x00.d: The cut NBC never aired: longer than the broadcast premiere, differently assembled, and the only episode of the series that was never sold anywhere. It opens on Peter Petrelli standing at the edge of a New York rooftop, falling forward -- and waking in an apartment as Simone Deveaux comes in.

Making of the Damen Peak Video, Part 1.d: A two-part behind-the-scenes piece on the Damen Peak shorts, posted during the Heroes Reborn campaign and lost when the channel carrying it went down.

Making of the Damen Peak Video, Part 2.d: The second half of the Damen Peak making-of. Like the first, no copy is known to survive.
